title: Faucet stroke deletion scope too broad: click on one of two crossing lines deletes BOTH whole lines; connectivity ignores stroke style
description:
VERIFIED behavior (repro below); the authentic Flash 8 scope is PARTIALLY UNCONFIRMED (needs an oracle check on real Flash 8) — hence low priority, but the current behavior is over-broad under every candidate reading.

CURRENT: faucetEraseShape (engine/planar/eraser.ts:224-329) picks the stroked half-edge near the click then BFS's connectedStrokeRun across ALL stroked half-edges sharing a vertex, regardless of (a) stroke STYLE and (b) whether the shared vertex is a mere CROSSING. Repro (origin/main b4430b6): two crossing pencil lines (0,50)->(100,50) and (50,0)->(50,100), faucet click at (10,50) -> EVERYTHING deleted (both entire lines; result shape null). Flash 8's faucet deletes 'the stroke segment or fill area' clicked — in merge mode an intersection SPLITS strokes into segments; the faucet click never wipes an unrelated line that merely crosses the clicked one. (Exact Flash scope to verify on a real oracle: single inter-intersection segment vs the connected same-style run; the rectangle-outline-in-one-click workflow suggests connected same-style runs are deleted THROUGH corners, but NOT through crossings with other strokes, and never across style changes.)

ALSO: pickStrokeNear tolerance is a fixed 3 stage-px (eraser.ts:264) — not zoom-adjusted, so at 400% zoom the faucet feels 12px sloppy and at 25% nearly impossible to hit; and the StageArea faucet path (StageArea.tsx:2211-2225) only operates on merged mergeable shapes at (0,0) — clicking legacy/transformed artwork silently does nothing.

SUGGESTED FIX: stop BFS at (a) style boundaries (compare lineStyle index) and (b) crossing vertices (degree>2 vertices where the continuation is not the geometric continuation of the clicked run — or simply restrict to the clicked segment's chain up to intersections, matching single-click stroke selection semantics in subselection.ts if available); divide tolerance by zoom. Verify the corner-vs-crossing rule against real Flash 8 before finalizing.

ACCEPTANCE: two crossing lines, faucet on one arm -> the other LINE survives intact (at minimum its far segments); black line touching a red line -> red survives; rectangle outline stroke faucet-click behavior matched to the real-Flash oracle decision recorded in the task. Related: 1322 (introduced faucet), 1387. Found by brush/eraser Flash-8 fidelity audit.
